commands.command: set -u; EXPECTED='8ef2da7e44f72137e840c710acdae80a539c226e'; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; XML='/tmp/tracker-shade-diagnostic-v1.xml'; actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo expected_sha=$EXPECTED; *) exit 13;; esac; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-shade-diagnostic-v1.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 && adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-shade-diagnostic-v1.xml > "$XML"; }; coords(){ python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 20; sleep 3; dump || exit 21; c=$(coords content-desc Menu || true); test -n "$c" || exit 22; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; dump; c=$(coords text Settings || true); test -n "$c" || exit 23; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; dump; c=$(coords text 'Alerts & Collection' || true); test -n "$c" || exit 24; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 2; i=1; tc=''; while [ $i -le 8 ]; do dump || true; tc=$(coords text 'Test alert' || true); [ -n "$tc" ] && break; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 540 1750 540 700 300 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 0.5; i=$((i+1)); done; echo test_alert_coords=$tc; test -n "$tc" || exit 31; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $tc; sleep 1; dump || true; echo '--- app alert status ---'; grep -oE 'text="(POSTED|BLOCKED_BY_POLICY|FAILED|No alert dispatched yet|Test alert)[^"]*"' "$XML" | tail -n 20 || true; echo '--- active TEST records before shade ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | awk '/Notification List:/{p=1} /mArchive=Archive/{p=0} p' | grep -E 'pkg=io\.blueeye.*tag=TEST|tag=TEST.*pkg=io\.blueeye' || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 540 40 540 1800 650 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 2; dump || true; echo '--- packages after physical shade swipe ---'; grep -o 'package="[^"]*"' "$XML" | sort -u | head -n 20 || true; echo '--- stop action after physical shade swipe ---'; grep -oE 'text="[^"]*Stop alarm[^"]*"|content-desc="[^"]*Stop alarm[^"]*"' "$XML" || true; echo PHASE3_ALERT_S22_SHADE_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURED
